bull.point: Revenue growth is accelerating significantly, reaching 53% year-on-year in the latest quarter.
bull.evidence: Sep 2026 revenue of ₹9,899 Cr vs ₹6,477 Cr in Sep 2025 (53% YoY)

bull.point: The company demonstrates exceptional capital efficiency with high returns and a virtually debt-free balance sheet.
bull.evidence: ROCE of 33.2% and Debt to Equity ratio of 0.02

bull.point: Cash flow generation is robust, with operating cash flow significantly exceeding reported profits in the latest year.
bull.evidence: CFO to PAT ratio of 140.73% for Mar 2026 and 105% over 6 years

bear.point: Operating margins have declined compared to the previous year and remain under pressure.
bear.evidence: Latest-quarter margin 14% vs 16% a year ago

bear.point: Management expects the working capital cycle to deteriorate from current levels to a higher long-term range.
bear.evidence: Current cycle 39 days; management guidance range is 45 to 50 days

bear.point: FMEG segment profitability remains a concern for analysts despite long-term targets.
bear.evidence: Analyst concerns regarding FMEG margin sustainability and drivers in Oct 2026 call

watch_next: Whether EBITDA margins stay within the guided 11% to 13% range.
If working capital cycle trends toward the guided 45-50 days.
Progress on the ₹60 billion to ₹80 billion five-year capex program.
